column1: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti about 2 minutes short of the package time.
Meanwhile, grind the peppercorns to your preferred amount.
About 3 minutes before the pasta is done, toast the pepper in a large dry skillet over high heat for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add 1/3–1/2 cup hot pasta water to the pepper and stir constantly over high heat for 30–45 seconds, then take off the heat.
In a small bowl, mix the pecorino and parmesan with 1/3–1/2 cup hot pasta water to form a creamy paste.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add the drained spaghetti and the cheese mixture, and toss quickly, adding splashes of pasta water as needed.
Cook about 1 minute until the pasta is done and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve topped with more black pepper and pecorino.
